title: Flat exp cost
description: Makes it so every level costs the same
body:
So i noticed that there where mods like this but none that did it for neoforge 1.21.1 so i made it and uploaded it here because why not. The mod will make very exp level cost only 50 exp.

Created by Goldentalon55. you may use this in a modpack if you please but please do give credit.
